raw.rationale: Brimonidine is a highly polar alpha2-adrenergic agonist with poor passive permeability and rapid ocular clearance, so at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to produce lineage-selective cytotoxicity; PRISM single-concentration data for such compounds typically show weak, non-selective effects near baseline. Any apparent lineage selectivity would be rare and driven by ADRA2A/B/C expression or transporter differences, but no published evidence supports a selective lineage kill.
